commits.subject: add pull request template. Fix issue templates.
commits.reason: Hollycast already has its own issue and PR templates. The PR template filename would collide on Windows.

commits.subject: Fetch translations & Recreate libretro_core_options_intl.h
commits.reason: Refresh Spanish and Swedish Libretro option text.

commits.subject: libretro: add a Vblank Pacing option (#2562)
commits.reason: Add opt-in Libretro Vblank Pacing for non-threaded rendering.

commits.subject: dreamcast: Default broadcast follows the region
commits.reason: Default the broadcast standard to PAL for Europe and NTSC elsewhere.

commits.subject: Fetch translations & Recreate libretro_core_options_intl.h
commits.reason: The bulk generated refresh needs regeneration against Hollycast's option definitions. The upstream Vblank Pacing localization strings are all empty.

commits.subject: ci: enable macOS build
commits.reason: Hollycast already builds macOS in CI. The upstream zstd uninstall is specific to Flycast's dependency setup.

commits.subject: bba: don't [de]serialize bba if not available on the current platform
commits.reason: Skip BBA state I/O when the device does not exist on the current emulated platform.

commits.subject: reios: pass correct data size to GetMemPtr when reading sectors
commits.reason: Validate the whole GD-ROM sector read against the available RAM span, and bound the sector count before converting it to bytes.

commits.subject: vk: fix some validation errors
commits.reason: Transition the Vulkan RTT depth attachment and synchronize presentation per swapchain image while retaining Hollycast's timing and resize handling.

commits.subject: oboe: add 200 ms timeout to push() to avoid ANR when pausing game
commits.reason: Bound Oboe's producer wait to avoid hanging Android while pausing a game.

commits.subject: make sure settings.display.width/height is never null
commits.reason: Keep display dimensions positive on DX11, DX9, SDL, EGL and Android resize paths.

commits.subject: gl, dx9: recreate textures when an update changes their size or format (#2604)
commits.reason: Recreate OpenGL and DX9 textures when storage changes. Preserve Hollycast's texture preloading, filtering and RTT metadata.

commits.subject: gl, dx11: make video routing output opaque
commits.reason: Keep routed frames opaque in OpenGL and DX11 while retaining Hollycast's display shader chain.

commits.subject: vk, dx11: keep video routing output opaque under overlays
commits.reason: Keep routed output opaque under DX11 crosshairs and Vulkan overlays.

commits.subject: dcnet: frame gride support
commits.reason: Route Frame Gride through the DCNet Power Smash PPP protocol using Hollycast's endpoint resolver.

commits.subject: naomi: reset multiboard flag for decryted roms
commits.reason: Clear stale multiboard state for decrypted Naomi carts while retaining Hollycast's cart and Hikaru classification.

commits.subject: ci: continue-on-error since macOS is failing once again
commits.reason: Keep existing Hollycast CI failure reporting for the build matrix.

commits.subject: Fetch translations & Recreate libretro_core_options_intl.h
commits.reason: Refresh Asturian and Hebrew Libretro option text.

commits.subject: ci: mingw tentative fix
commits.reason: Hollycast's MinGW job already requests the MinGW make package through make:p.

commits.subject: ui: missing tooltips for bottom row of game list
commits.reason: Hollycast's library cards use their own item-hover details instead of Flycast's cover tooltip.

commits.subject: dx11: fix partial rendering for OIT
commits.reason: Preserve the previous DX11 OIT frame for partial draws. Copy into the larger OIT target when a larger RTT prevents swapping matching resources.

commits.subject: Force RTT Copy to VRAM for Pia Carrott 2 and Shinki Sekai Evolution
commits.reason: Force RTT Copy to VRAM for Pia Carrot 2 and Shinki Sekai Evolution.

commits.subject: CI macOS: install the universal dependency formulae from a local tap
commits.reason: Hollycast already installs and verifies universal macOS dependencies from its own local Homebrew tap.
